output.summary: One partner-led experiment tests adoption and price with paid commitments; decision rules cover every outcome.

proposals.hypothesis: At least 4 of 20 selected sites sign a paid pilot commitment at the stated annual price, and at least 8 complete a discovery interview.
proposals.method: Partner-led outreach and discovery interviews after G1 approval
proposals.sampleText: 20 sites from the reachable pool, selected by size and process, via the approved partner channel
proposals.couldFalsify: Fewer than 2 paid commitments from 20 qualified sites would contradict 20% adoption at this price.

claim.statement: A selected sample of 20 sites cannot establish the adoption rate of the whole pool; it can only falsify it.
